# Lending Policy Review and Update

This document details the critical areas requiring review and update within the bank's lending policy:

*   Review of interest rates standard update.
*   Review of borrower credit score based on audit findings.
*   Update of borrower credit score for strategy 2026.
*   Optimization of the default risk standard update.
*   Monitoring of collateral value quarterly.
